scope.authorization: fictional fixture written for this example

coverage.reason: no build output or runtime in scope

findings.title: Any caller can read any order (no ownership check)
findings.reproduction: GET /api/orders/1 with any or no x-user header returns another user's order.
findings.impact: Order details of every user are exposed by enumerating ids.
findings.fix: Look up the order, then return 404 unless order.owner equals the authenticated user id from the session (not a client header).

findings.title: Identity taken from a client-supplied header
findings.evidence: orders.set(id, { id, qty, price, owner: req.headers["x-user"] });
findings.reproduction: POST /api/orders with x-user: someone-else creates an order owned by that user.
findings.fix: Derive the owner from a verified session or token on the server.

findings.title: Order quantity and price are not validated
findings.evidence:
const { qty, price } = req.body;
  const cost = qty * price;
findings.impact: Negative or non-numeric quantities mint balance; strings produce NaN costs that pass the balance check.
findings.fix: Validate qty as a positive integer and price as a positive number on a tick grid; reject otherwise with 400.
findings.false_positive_notes: Would be lower if a validating proxy sits in front; none is in scope.

findings.title: Buy control is a div with a click handler
findings.reproduction: Tab through the page: the Buy control never receives focus; screen readers do not announce a button.
findings.impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot place an order.

findings.title: Zoom disabled and field labeled only by a placeholder
findings.reproduction: Pinch-zoom on a phone does not enlarge text; the quantity field has no label once typing starts.
findings.impact: Low-vision users cannot zoom; the field loses its name.
findings.fix: Remove maximum-scale; add <label for="qty">Quantity</label>; add lang on html.
